cases.title: Identity and delegation
invariants: Manager read is not mutation/delegation authority
Synthetic ceiling is not a grant to Stan
Researcher owner differs from deployer

cases.title: Shared alpha, separate version/portfolio grain
invariants: Fleet key is alpha_id + alpha_version_id + portfolio_id
Linked discovery is not peer-finance permission

cases.title: Shared physical pool, distinct economic accounts
invariants: Pool membership does not grant physical-custody disclosure
Dedupe economic source identity, never numeric equality

cases.title: Economic backing vs budget
invariants: Budget is not an economic cash transfer
No universal 1x exposure rule

cases.title: Partial recall and exact partition
invariants: Exact requested = applied + pending + cancelled + rejected
Unknown obligations never imply flat

cases.title: Ownership intervals and late obligation
invariants: Late fill retains original causal binding
Historical owner alone does not grant current read

cases.title: Duplicate intent/transport ACK
invariants: Same intent uses same idempotency key
Delivery ACK is not TS APPLIED
ACK follows durable commit

cases.title: Continuity and projection generations
invariants: Epoch is not projection generation
Opaque cursor is not global ordering
Missing source interval requires resync

cases.title: Revoke across surfaces
invariants: Recheck before query, cache result, export and commit
Committed obligations and late facts remain retained

cases.title: Flows are not PnL
invariants: Net balance 900 with PnL exactly zero
Flow-adjusted return requires its own methodology

cases.title: Decimals and equal amount dedupe
invariants: Two distinct source postings of 100 total 200
Duplicate source posting counts once
No float coercion or currency merging

cases.title: Resource profile is not measurement
invariants: Fixture limits are not production budgets
Performance receipt remains NOT_RUN

cases.title: Full business manager, limited mutation
invariants: Business read all is independent of technical secrets and delegation ceiling
No display-name authorization

cases.title: Restricted researcher schema
invariants: No hidden totals, peers, finance sort or inferred denominator
Current verified owner links only

cases.title: Fleet currency/stage semantics
invariants: All is navigation, never a financial stage
No mixed-domain NAV aggregate
Snapshot and policy bind paging

cases.title: Archive without liquidation
invariants: Archive is lifecycle, not financial stage
Paper clone is a separate deployment with approved lineage/quota

cases.title: Funding buckets
invariants: Initial/added/returned funds are flows
Do not invent lot PnL or turnover

cases.title: Raw vs contribution vs direct score
invariants: 73.3 fair provisional is a synthetic numerical example
18.325 contribution has no quality band
Direct NAV score is not an average of child q

cases.title: Correction of original source
invariants: Restatement creates a new calculation revision
Bounded recomputation outside TS hot path

cases.title: Actual versus virtual and Canary/Live
invariants: Canary/Live on same actual account counted once
Paper/Sandbox NAV never added to actual

cases.title: Same-basis provisional windows
invariants: Same comparable_basis_id does not require same subject evidence ref
Short history cannot pretend to be 30 days
Maturity policy still requires config

cases.title: Missing constituent, available direct NAV
invariants: Missing 25% q gives composition bounds [67.5,92.5], not a fabricated point
Direct NAV remains independently available
No substitution of composition for direct NAV

cases.title: Stress/cost absence and known zero
invariants: Missing stress bounds [65.175,77.675] do not license a numeric total
Known zero differs from missing cost/notional
No weight renormalization

cases.title: Forward diagnostic versus actual duration
invariants: Paper40+Sandbox20+actual10 may describe70 days but actual duration remains10
Version/overlap/cashflow gaps invalidate combined basis

cases.title: Fixed bands and independent model outputs
invariants: Band uses unrounded canonical value
Contribution never gets a quality band
No legacy HHI penalty or average-child fallback
